title: Hide optional question prompts after confirmed submission
description: An optional Codex answer accepted into the native queue remains displayed as an offered question with disabled controls and still contributes to pending counts. Hide exactly confirmed submitted optional requests from the question presentation while preserving native queue visibility, durable delivery tracking and unsent drafts.
design: Filter submitted optional requests at SessionsWindow presentation using QuestionCard delivery tracking. Preserve exact session, run, conversation, question ID and hash for submission recognition. Keep native pending records and queue semantics unchanged. Validate queue visibility, multiple unanswered requests, stale snapshots, persisted receipts and focus/draft preservation.
acceptance_criteria: Confirmed local submission and exact persisted answer_delivery receipts remove optional questions from the offered list and pending count. The next unanswered question becomes visible, or the composer regains focused input when none remain. Refresh, session switching and GUI reopening cannot reoffer submitted questions. Wrong identity, sending and uncertain delivery remain actionable or locked as appropriate. No automatic resend or queue promotion.
notes: Confirmed submissions now disappear from offered optional question cards and pending counts; the next unanswered request is shown while Activity retains the native queue. Regression tests cover real submit callbacks, stale snapshots, reopening, session switching, remaining drafts, exact delivery identity, uncertain answers, focus and no duplicate resend or queue promotion. Full QuestionCard suites passed on Linux/macOS, full Linux SessionsWindow suite and affected macOS integration cases passed. Source checks passed. GUI installed and restarted on both machines with CLI hashes and native process identities preserved.
close_reason: Hide confirmed submitted optional question prompts while keeping native queue and delivery tracking; verified and deployed on both platforms.

title: Keep message editor focus after sending a queued message
description: Sending from the focused Activity composer disables its editor while the native submission is in flight. Qt moves keyboard focus to another action, including Stop, and the editor does not regain it after successful queue submission. Preserve focus on the editor throughout sending without stealing focus from other controls or sessions, and keep the in-flight payload locked.
design: Keep the message editor enabled and temporarily read-only during in-flight delivery. Block paste/drop mutation and duplicate sends. Return focus from an explicitly focused Send button to its editor before locking. Do not move focus during delivery completion or background callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Enter submission keeps focus associated with the same message editor while the payload is locked and after it enters the native queue. No implicit focus transfer to Stop and no duplicate send. Background delivery and deliberate navigation preserve the user-selected focus and unrelated drafts. Tests cover message/question submit context.
notes: Regression reproduced focus moving to interruptAgent for both Enter and focused Send-button submission before the fix. Full MessageComposer suite passes on Linux and macOS. Full affected Linux window suite and targeted queue/session identity/focus tests on both platforms pass. GUI installed and restarted on both machines; CLI binaries and sampled native process identities preserved.
close_reason: Implemented guarded per-question Enter submission and retained message editor focus during delivery; validated and deployed on both platforms.

title: Submit question freeform answers with Enter
description: The Activity question freeform editor captures text changes but has no returnPressed handler, so Enter leaves a valid answer unsent. Route Return and keypad Enter through the same guarded submit action as the visible button, preserving validation, submission locks, request identity and approval review.
design: Connect each question freeform editor returnPressed signal to that QuestionCard submit action, requiring a visible submit button. Reuse existing completeness, availability, uncertainty and duplicate guards. Verify ordinary composer drafts remain untouched when both forms are visible.
acceptance_criteria: Return and keypad Enter submit a valid freeform or Other answer exactly once through answerRequested. Empty/invalid, unsupported, unavailable, uncertain and already submitted questions cannot be sent with Enter. Hidden submit actions on earlier pages and approval forms are not bypassed.
notes: Validated full QuestionCard suite on Linux and macOS, including Return/keypad Enter for freeform and Other answers, validation and duplicate guards, navigation and approval guards. SessionsWindow integration confirms the owning question submits while the ordinary composer draft remains untouched. Deployed verified GUI on both development machines.
close_reason: Implemented guarded per-question Enter submission and retained message editor focus during delivery; validated and deployed on both platforms.

title: Support account permissions on resident legacy DeepSeek adapters
description: Upgrade account-mode compatibility without restarting the native DeepSeek host or replacing live conversations. Legacy residents lack accountPermissions; add a verified native-API compatibility path for explicitly requested new/resumed-session modes and validate capabilities before recording new bindings. Preserve native defaults, running-session modes, exact conversation identity and save-before-RPC uncertainty protection.
design: Use the released authenticated permissionPresets/catalog and commands/execute APIs to extend legacy residents. Never reload their bridge because disposal closes owned agents. Preflight before saving a new binding; still persist identity before create RPC. Mark setup pending until native projection confirms the exact requested preset. Preserve running agents, host generation and existing conversation IDs; do not silently downgrade bypass or automatically retry uncertain messages.
acceptance_criteria: New/resumed sessions on a resident legacy bridge obtain the verified native danger-full-access preset without host restart; already-running agents retain their mode/history. Unsupported preset capability creates no new binding. Unconfirmed setup blocks sends/settings/recovery until explicit resume verifies the same identity, and confirmed permissions are not reapplied. Native modern/legacy contract tests and minimum-Rust checks pass; installed CLI resolves the reported failed session.
notes: Implemented native-API compatibility and deterministic preflight before identity persistence. Pending setup gates send/settings/recovery; explicit resume reads the native preset before attempting a command, preventing repetition after uncertain acknowledgement. Six legacy keyless tests, nineteen current Harness tests, DeepSeek account lifecycle test and 135 Rust tests on stable/minimum 1.85 passed; release build installed locally. The affected saved conversation now reports Ready/send_available with native danger-full-access. Existing host PID/start identity/generation and another open agent preset/history revision were preserved; no message/model request was submitted during live repair.
close_reason: Legacy DeepSeek adapters now support verified account bypass through the native web API without restart. Capability preflight prevents phantom cards; unconfirmed setup is safely recoverable on explicit resume. Modern/legacy/account contract suites, stable/minimum-Rust tests and release build passed. Installed the CLI and repaired the affected saved session with its exact identity; the resident host and another native agent were preserved.

title: Restore verified input after forking a Codex session
description: A newly forked Codex session remains Status unknown with an empty Activity view and disabled Send button, waiting for the requested conversation to be confirmed. Reproduce the native fork startup/identity binding, fix the verified readiness path without relaxing parent/child isolation or retrying user input, add regression coverage, and deploy the tested update while preserving all native sessions.
acceptance_criteria: A genuine child conversation is recognized after native fork startup and accepts verified Activity input; parent identity and live processes remain untouched; wrong/stale/unconfirmed bindings still reject input; isolated regression tests pass; no hosted CI is dispatched.
notes: Reproduced the missing first-message permission against the installed CLI. The live Codex process already owned a distinct native child rollout with matching forked_from_id, while SessionStart remained deferred. Added strict bootstrap verification of the recorded Codex fork recipe, exact process/supervisor, owned child history under the correct account, working-folder options and empty terminal composer; native hooks still own identity confirmation. New image-send/replay and wrong-history/process/account/directory regressions pass. Linux: 135 Rust tests (stable and MSRV), 36 input tests, 5 fork contracts, 101 lifecycle tests (1 existing skip), 6 effort tests and 3 Qt startup variants passed. macOS: 133 Rust tests, 36 input tests and 5 fork contracts passed. Both final release CLIs are atomically installed; all 8 sampled Linux native identities were preserved, and the existing fork now reports first_message_can_send=true without synthetic hooks. No GUI or native agents were restarted and no hosted CI was dispatched.
close_reason: Verified native fork bootstrap input is implemented, covered on Linux/macOS and deployed atomically to both CLIs. The existing live fork accepts its first message without recreation, parent mutation, synthetic SessionStart or input replay. Documentation is updated; hosted CI remains manual-only.

title: Make hosted CI manual-only with explicit expensive suites
description: Hosted CI exhausted the account quota. Remove automatic push and pull-request checks, default manual runs to inexpensive Ubuntu source and minimum-Rust checks, require explicit selection for Linux integration, Arch packaging and macOS coverage, and stop release candidates from implicitly rerunning macOS. Support owner-selected PR refs, document the budget policy, and validate locally without dispatching hosted jobs.
acceptance_criteria: No automatic push/PR CI; macOS disabled by default in CI and releases; owner can manually select suites and target ref; selected-job gate rejects failures and unexpected skips; local workflow validation passes; changes pushed without starting hosted checks.
notes: Removed push/pull_request triggers; combined source and Rust 1.85 checks into one default Ubuntu job; optional suites wait for quick checks and use an exact resolved target SHA, including manual PR refs. Dynamic CLI matrix allocates macOS only when requested. Release candidates explicitly request Linux/Arch, with macOS false by default. Gate allows only intentionally unselected skips and is omitted on quick-only runs. Local actionlint/source/privacy checks and all 8 selections/104 gate scenarios passed; no hosted dispatch. AGENTS/CLAUDE, contributing guide, release runbook and owner questionnaire reflect the confirmed budget policy.
close_reason: Implemented manual-only hosted CI with one default Ubuntu job, explicit Linux/Arch/macOS suite selection, exact-commit manual PR checks, selected-result validation and macOS opt-in for release candidates. Local actionlint, source checks and 8 selections/104 gate scenarios passed without hosted dispatch. Documentation and agent instructions record the owner budget policy.

title: Keep Activity question cards compact and scroll long content
description: Question cards reserve a large empty form area and obscure the Activity context. Size short forms to their current content, cap longer forms relative to the Activity area, and keep question content independently scrollable with reachable actions and preserved drafts.
design: Size only the current form page to its wrapped content. Limit the whole card to about 45 percent of its Activity parent and 360 px, while reserving a small usable viewport and keeping the freeform editor and actions visible. Recalculate after window resizing, question navigation, answer visibility and theme/font changes.
acceptance_criteria: Short freeform questions leave no large blank area. Long text and choices scroll inside a bounded card; Activity stays usable at narrow and short window sizes. Synthetic Qt regression checks cover resizing and question navigation.
notes: Implemented content-sized current pages and a viewport-relative card limit (about 45 percent, at most 360 px, with a small minimum reading area). Freeform answers and action buttons remain outside the scrolling prompt/options. Verified short and long forms, independent history scrolling, narrow-window resizing, navigation and draft retention. All 30 Linux Qt suites passed. The macOS question-card suite and 19 affected window checks passed. Synthetic previews remain outside Git. Installed the verified GUI on Linux and macOS; CLI hashes and sampled native process identities were preserved.
close_reason: Both GUI corrections are implemented, tested on Linux and macOS, and installed on the development machines. Native sessions and CLI binaries were preserved.

title: Prepare tested Arch/AUR packaging and publication handoff
description: Prepare reproducible packaging for the Zerus GUI and compatible hgs CLI, research current AUR rules and name availability, validate staged packages without touching user sessions, and document release/publication choices plus all remaining owner actions. The current upstream repository is private; do not change visibility or publish public AUR material without the owner decision.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewed PKGBUILD/SRCINFO and bundle staging/install paths are tested where possible, CI packaging checks exist, and an English handoff provides recommended choices, exhaustive owner questionnaire, account/SSH/public-source requirements, exact release/publication steps and honestly stated validation limits.
notes: Prepared and tested system ADE bundle preserving hgs/HGS_* and desktop IDs, explicit conflict-preserving zerus-setup and all three AUR flavors. Full main CI 37705887611 and artifact-only release 37705888076 passed at 548469a. Downloaded all four hashes and generated SRCINFO pairs verified; actual binary pacman install, repeated setup and isolated terminal session passed in disposable Arch. English docs/ci-and-aur.md contains 18 owner questions and ten publication actions. SVG runtime plugin omission was reproduced and fixed; no public release/AUR push or native restart. Public source/account/naming/contact/signing decisions and fresh public yay roundtrip remain zerus-dym.
close_reason: CI/release automation and source/binary/VCS packaging are implemented and validated end to end. Private exact-source candidate is downloaded; installed binary and canonical AUR metadata checks passed. Exhaustive English owner handoff is complete; public publication remains a separate owner-decision task.

title: Configure continuous integration for CLI and desktop builds
description: Evaluate the existing Rust, Python/private-PTY and Qt test suites; configure practical GitHub Actions checks and build artifacts for Linux and macOS without credentials or live agent state. Validate workflows and run the configured checks.
acceptance_criteria: Pull requests and main pushes run meaningful source checks, isolated CLI integration tests and desktop builds/tests with reproducible toolchain/dependency choices, bounded jobs and visible failure logs.
notes: Verified CI fixture root causes (2026-10-08): async account catalogs may select another provider before Codex. The restore test must explicitly select native-codex. The loading fixture must release the remote catalog only after local inspections are queued: two held remote inspections otherwise occupy both AccountUsageStore slots and prevent the intended local-only snapshot. These fixes preserve runtime behavior and remove assumptions about subprocess ordering.
close_reason: Implemented and validated the full GitHub Actions matrix: all seven jobs passed in main run 37704073894, including both CLI/desktop platforms and installed Arch bundle checks. Ordering-sensitive account fixtures passed ten consecutive runs per platform.

title: Handle Codex question answers accepted into the native queue
description: An optional question answer entered the Codex native input queue while the agent was busy, but the adapter timed out waiting for the recorded reply and showed an uncertain-delivery error. Track verified queued delivery separately from recorded answers, preserve exact question/run/conversation identity, disable duplicate submission and reconcile when native delivery completes. Present the queued state clearly using synthetic fixtures; never retry or promote input automatically.
design: Use a durable submitted status rather than inferring queue delivery from bounded native queue previews. Preserve exact run/conversation/question hash and canonical answers in the private question cache and receipt. Recover legacy in-progress composer attempts only from exact submitted input receipts. No automatic retry or queue promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Verified native submission returns submitted instead of a timeout error, without claiming Codex has recorded the answer. Pending-question UI restores the exact submitted answer and blocks duplicate answers and Skip, resolves on the actual native reply, and rejects stale or mismatched evidence. Both normal-composer and native-panel fixtures pass without live agent state.
notes: Implemented a durable submitted status for optional Codex answers, distinct from native recorded replies. Exact scoped answers restore across polling, session switches and GUI restarts; duplicate answers and Skip are blocked. Both composer and native-panel queues pass private PTY regression tests on Linux and macOS (10 each); Linux input transport 34, generic questions 8 and Rust 135 passed; macOS Rust 133 passed. Affected Linux GUI suites passed; macOS queued-answer, receipt and card checks passed. An existing macOS coldCacheClearKeepsDraftAndPinsIdentity check failed in the full suite and passed on isolated rerun. Installed matching CLI and GUI builds on Linux and macOS, restarted only the GUI and verified existing native process identities. Synthetic preview remains outside Git.
close_reason: Queued Codex question answers retain exact submitted identity and wait for the recorded reply without false timeout errors, duplicate submission or automatic queue promotion. Verified and deployed on Linux and macOS.

title: Publish approved README and desktop fix, and deploy the GUI update
description: Commit and push the approved English documentation, four synthetic screenshots and local file/folder opening fix. Synchronize the reviewed Beads database. Verify the existing local GUI deployment and update the configured macOS desktop installation without restarting native agents, tmux servers or DeepSeek hosts.
acceptance_criteria: Changes are pushed to origin/main, Beads is synchronized, desktop installations use the verified update, and native process identities are preserved.
notes: Deployment verified on the existing Linux and macOS GUI installations. Installed binaries/bundles match their builds, desktop services are running, CLI binaries are unchanged, and native process identities were preserved. Preparing the approved source commit and remote synchronization.
close_reason: Approved changes were deployed on Linux and macOS, pushed to origin/main as 9b836f5, and synchronized through the Beads Dolt remote. Both GUIs match their builds; native process identities and CLI binaries were preserved.

title: Fix local file and folder opening from the file-reference dialog
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Open a local file reference in Activity on Linux/Wayland and click Open file or Open folder.

## Actual Behavior
The requested desktop application does not visibly open. The file exists, and xdg-open succeeds with the desktop application environment. Investigate the Qt dispatch path and modal-dialog lifetime without touching native agent processes.

## Acceptance Criteria
Both actions launch the expected local path reliably, failures remain visible, and the dialog preserves path safety. Cover the verified root cause with an isolated regression test.
acceptance_criteria: Open file and Open folder launch the expected local path reliably after dialog destruction. Copy path keeps local and remote dialogs open so the user can copy first and then open the file, folder or SSH terminal. Failures remain visible; regression tests use isolated synthetic paths.
notes: Queued file/folder dispatch after modal destruction fixes the Qt Wayland activation-token lifetime bug. Copy path now keeps local and remote dialogs open; tests cover copying before file, folder and SSH actions. The full Linux sessionswindow suite passed 140 tests with two existing skips, the three dialog cases passed on macOS, and the real Wayland fixture opened each requested target once. The verified GUI update is installed on both platforms.
close_reason: Implemented and deployed: copy keeps the dialog open; opening actions dispatch after its destruction. Linux, macOS and Wayland fixture checks passed.

title: Show Codex hook trust requests in Activity
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Start a supervised Codex session with new or changed hooks. The native terminal shows Hooks need review while Activity has no request.

## Acceptance Criteria
Recognize the complete native prompt, present its disclosure and explicit review/trust/continue-without-trusting choices in Activity, scope every action to the current run and prompt, and never approve hooks or retry uncertain delivery automatically. Cover startup without a conversation, changed prompts, review transitions and duplicate submissions with isolated tests.
close_reason: Implemented native startup hook consent in Activity, including explicit choices, scoped Review-to-Terminal navigation, stale request rejection and idempotent receipts. Rust tests, isolated tmux transport tests and the three affected Qt suites passed.

title: Prepare the clean Zerus repository
description: Create a source snapshot with MIT licensing, sanitized examples and portable deployment configuration. Initialize fresh Beads with verified open work and durable product constraints. Validate source, tests and secret scans before pushing the private repository. Preserve the predecessor as an archive.
close_reason: Sanitized MIT source and fresh Beads were pushed to the private Zerus repository. An independent clone restored all reviewed source, 9 new issue records and 10 curated memories from the new remote. The predecessor repository is now archived and remains private. Validation is recorded in docs/validation.md; future work continues here.

title: Publish first public Arch/AUR release after owner decisions
description: Complete the first public distribution after the owner answers docs/ci-and-aur.md: choose public upstream or audited mirror, package names, AUR ownership/public contact, first version and CI/release policies. Register the owner-controlled AUR account/key, verify public immutable assets, push reviewed PKGBUILD/SRCINFO pairs and verify a fresh yay install. Preparation does not authorize changing repository visibility or publishing public packages.
acceptance_criteria: The owner-selected source/release URLs work anonymously; chosen AUR recipes are published under the approved account/contact; a disposable Arch desktop verifies yay installation, per-user compatibility setup and upgrades preserving native processes; docs advertise only the verified public package URLs.
notes: CI policy Q6 is confirmed as of 2026-10-08: owner-triggered checks only, no push/PR automation, one Ubuntu job by default, explicit Linux/Arch/macOS opt-ins and macOS off for Arch release candidates. Implemented in zerus-1my. Public source, package names, AUR ownership/contact and release publication choices remain owner decisions; see docs/ci-and-aur.md.

title: Recognize project worktrees in the new-session folder preview
description: A new or existing linked worktree selected for a project is presented as an outside-project folder because the preview only tests saved folder IDs. Recognize verified worktree catalogs belonging to the selected project and machine, while preserving warnings for unrelated folders and keeping launch-only folder selections local to the dialog.
design: Require an available non-bare checkout catalog containing both the selected path and a saved project folder on the selected machine. Keep successful creation evidence in the dialog until the refreshed catalog catches up; recheck it against current project folders. Preserve project catalogs and normal folder launch behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Created and selected linked worktrees show a neutral project-worktree preview. Unrelated repositories and plain folders retain the warning. Project and machine changes cannot reuse stale membership evidence. Synthetic local and remote cases pass.
notes: Verified worktree catalogs now connect the selected folder to saved project folders on the same machine. Successful creation retains dialog-local membership until catalog refresh; unrelated, bare and unavailable folders keep the warning. Existing-picker, new-worktree, subdirectory, project-switch and machine-switch checks passed (10 worktree-panel checks on Linux and macOS), along with the full Linux GUI suites and affected macOS window scenarios. No project folders or worktrees are created implicitly.
close_reason: Both GUI corrections are implemented, tested on Linux and macOS, and installed on the development machines. Native sessions and CLI binaries were preserved.

title: Render native question replies as readable Activity answer cards
description: Codex optional-question replies appear in Activity as a raw send_user_message_question_reply envelope with JSON and transport IDs. Render recognized replies with a clear question and answer, preserving literal content and message identity. Keep unrecognized or malformed messages intact and do not change native delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Known native reply envelopes render readable question/answer cards without exposed transport markup. Escaping, unsupported input fallback and existing Activity behavior are covered by synthetic tests. Deploy and push the approved correction.
notes: Implemented readable native reply cards for journal, recorded context, local delivery and search. Question context is muted; the literal answer has its own highlighted section. Strict envelope/schema recognition preserves malformed or example input, and escaping prevents markup/resources from becoming active. Full Activity suites passed on Linux and macOS (89 tests each, one existing preview skip); synthetic light/dark previews remain outside Git. Installed both GUIs and verified build identity, running services, unchanged CLI binaries and native process identities.
close_reason: Readable answer cards were validated on Linux and macOS, deployed with native process preservation, and pushed to origin/main as 2f62568. Synthetic previews remain outside Git.

title: Refresh product README and capture synthetic feature screenshots
description:
## Summary
Replace the exhaustive README with a compact ADE presentation centered on persistent tmux sessions, multi-machine work, notifications and peer-to-peer project/config synchronization. Show supported native integrations including DeepSeek Harness as icons. Capture the real Qt UI with synthetic fixture data and keep screenshots out of commits pending owner review.

## Acceptance Criteria
Concise README with linked operational documentation, truthful support scope and mobile roadmap. Reviewable screenshots of core features contain only synthetic data. No source or tracker commit, push or remote sync.
notes:
Replaced the exhaustive README with a compact English product page, four agent icon badges including DeepSeek Harness, a mobile roadmap and four real Qt screenshots with synthetic data. Added English installation and operational reference documents, mirrored the English-language rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and verified 27 local links plus desktop/narrow previews. Selected lossless WebP images total 200572 bytes; capture fixtures and originals stay outside the repository. No commits or remote sync.
After the owner approved publication, the English documentation and four reviewed screenshots were committed and pushed as 9b836f5. Publication and verified Linux/macOS deployment are tracked in zerus-3at. The current English operational reference is an edited adaptation of the original manual; capture fixtures and screenshot originals remain outside Git.
close_reason: Implemented and verified; local changes remain uncommitted for owner review.

title: Prepare public binary dependency notices and packaging
description:
## Description

Before distributing binary releases, collect licenses, copyright notices and any required source/relinking materials for the exact Qt, Chromium, KDE and Rust dependencies shipped. Verify clean installation on Linux and macOS and add repeatable build/secret-scan CI. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is a source inventory, not a completed binary distribution notice bundle.

## Acceptance Criteria

Repeatable release validation and exact shipped dependency notices are reviewed before public binary distribution.

title: Promote ordinary Codex deferred follow-ups
description:
## Summary

src/state/input_queue.rs only promotes Codex pending steers when the native UI explicitly offers Escape to interrupt and send. Ordinary deferred follow-ups remain read-only in Activity. Add verified native promotion preserving draft, attachments, order and exact queue identity. Never use generic Escape for an unsupported queue type.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.

title: Read Claude context capacity from native telemetry
description:
## Summary

Claude usage currently provides tokens without verified context-window capacity. Add a composable native statusline telemetry reader scoped to run, conversation and model, preserving existing user statusline configuration. Handle stale data, model changes and compaction. Do not infer capacity from a model name.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.

title: Change Claude model and effort from Activity
description:
## Summary

src/state/effort.rs directs Claude model and effort changes to Terminal. Add verified per-session native controls with capability checks, preserving account defaults and drafts. Cover Linux and macOS behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.

title: Support native DeepSeek context reset when available
description:
## Summary

Clear context is intentionally disabled for DeepSeek because the integrated native SessionController has no supported reset method. Add a capability-gated native reset when the upstream interface supports it. Preserve conversation identity and never truncate provider-owned history or replace a running agent.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.

title: Avoid executing custom launchers during capability detection
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

Run the custom-launcher cases in tests/test_pause.py.

## Actual Behavior

The Codex capability probe in src/state/lifecycle.rs invokes the configured executable with --help before a supervised run exists. Custom launchers may block, exit, or produce side effects before run identity is recorded. Detect capabilities without executing a user wrapper outside supervision. Cover failed, cancelled and requested-conversation startup in tests/test_pause.py.

## Expected Behavior

Launchers run only inside supervision and failures retain the intended run identity.

## Acceptance Criteria

Regression tests reproduce the original condition and pass reliably after a verified fix, without bypassing identity checks or relying on another account.

title: Stabilize account-loading test under parallel GUI test load
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

Run GUI tests with ctest --test-dir tray/build -j 4.

## Actual Behavior

During the clean-repository validation, accountspage::initialLoadingPublishesOnlyGroupedAccounts timed out at the first four local rows under ctest -j 4. The isolated case and the predecessor full account suite pass; AccountsPage production source is unchanged. Investigate the fake inspect process barriers and deadlines so the test reliably exercises incremental local-first loading under parallel load without hiding product failures.

## Acceptance Criteria

The account-loading test reliably verifies incremental local-first loading under parallel test load and continues to detect real grouping regressions.

title: Expose supported DeepSeek fork, history and scheduling operations
description:
## Summary

The native DeepSeek integration leaves fork, global history search and schedule management in Native UI. Evaluate supported native APIs and expose useful operations in Zerus while preserving account/conversation identity and native engine ownership. See design/deepseek-harness/index.html.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.
